title: Austin Budget: Public Safety, Health, Parks
summary:
*   City officials dedicated a four-hour work session to planning the Capital Improvements Program (CIP) Budget.
*   Discussions centered on funding for critical public services, including community programs, public health initiatives, public safety, and recreational facilities.
*   The session involved presentations and deliberations aimed at shaping future investments in Austin's infrastructure and services.

Memorandum To:
Mayor Cooksey called to order the meeting of the Council, noting the absence of
Councilmembers Urdy and Rose.
The Mayor announced the purpose of the meeting was for a work session on the Capital
Improvements Program - Budget. Council discussed and heard presentations on Public and
Community Services, Public Health, Public Safety and Recreation.
The meeting was adjourned at 8:00 p.m.
